selection: Retrospective piecewise-linear calibration between documented institutional anchors and the 2026 current-structure endpoint; no historical association evidence is backdated before its verified year.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Current ITF association evidence is used only from 2026 and does not establish historical membership timing.
No rankings, titles or athlete results are used to fit ratings.
2026 is partial through the bundle cutoff, not a forecast.
Linear interpolation is a transparent project-authored reconstruction between sparse anchors, not measured annual sporting change.

construction.description: Values before the first verified institutional anchor retain the prior low-confidence baseline. From the verified institutional anchor onward, annual project estimates are linearly interpolated between explicit numeric anchors and rounded to one decimal. Later endpoint evidence is used retrospectively to reconstruct history; it is not claimed to have been measured in earlier years.
